vibe_rationale: Community-run, curated, multi-format regional arts festival in a climbing town with a strong local culture; small and biennial.
fit_notes: Adult creative and climbing crowd in a small regional town (about 3,200 in 2025, organiser-reported), and VicHealth backed the 2025 festival, so a health precedent exists. Climbing access at Mt Arapiles has been restricted since November 2024, a live community issue to handle with care. A workshop or wellness-zone role is a natural, low-cost first step.
